## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D Hades-style room clear with three weapon choices” game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using HTML, CSS, and Canvas JavaScript.
- Assumed a three-room run with spear, dual blades, and bow choices; keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the title/menu, weapon selection, HUD, pause/end screens, responsive touch controls, and game arena.
- Implemented movement, aiming, attacks, dash, enemy waves and attacks, health, room progression, and win/loss states.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Browser verification and visual check have not been completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game at `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright, inspect the menu and gameplay, and check browser console errors.
2. Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.
3. Summarize the finished game and briefly state assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and weapon/menu/HUD overlays.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layout.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, controls, combat, and room progression.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `game.js` passed syntax validation, but no browser test or screenshot has been performed.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D Hades-style room clear with three weapon choices” game in the existing repository.

- Added title/menu, weapon selection, HUD, pause/end screens, responsive touch controls, and arena visuals.
- Implemented movement, aiming, attacks, dash, enemy waves and attacks, health, room progression, and win/loss states.
- `node --check game.js` passed; game opened at `http://localhost:3002`.

### Active
